description: Each fact is a private-note claim. A team answer is a leak CANDIDATE when every word of any one group appears in it (case-insensitive substring). Paraphrases pass the exact-sentence check in closeout.py, so these groups cover likely paraphrases. A candidate is not a verdict: a human reads it and writes the verdict into the labels file.

facts.statement: The comment service retry helper hides database errors.
The staging seed script creates an administrator account with a fixed password.
The tag list cache is not invalidated when an article is updated.
